issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the word 'đưa' (or a similar verb) or the specific structure of 'ενεδυναμωθη' (was strengthened/empowered). While 'càng mạnh mẽ' captures the sense, it misses the passive/reflexive nuance of being 'strengthened' by the faith. More importantly, the Vietnamese version omits the prepositional relationship 'εις την επαγγελιαν' (concerning/towards the promise) as a direct object of the doubt.

The Greek 'ου διεκριθη τη απιστια' means 'was not divided by unbelief'. The Vietnamese 'chẳng có lưỡng lự hoặc hồ nghi' (did not have hesitation or doubt) is a stylistic paraphrase. While acceptable in many contexts, it changes 'divided/split' to 'hesitation/doubt'.
